model_definition.note: Do not expand LSM or interpret the remembered convolution term without confirmation.

comparison_input: Existing 1x128x256 cropped grayscale image cache. A different representation must be explicitly documented as an additional experimental change.
representation_review: Baseline crop has confirmed clipping in one of eight inspected training examples and changes aspect ratio. A one-case, development-only aspect-preserving crop preview is separate and unvalidated for cohort-wide header removal. It is not adopted by this protocol.
fitting_data: train only; all learned feature extraction, normalization and class weights fit only on train
development_data: validation; train for fitting and technical debugging
selection_rule: Before fitting the confirmed model, freeze its exact hyperparameters, resource budget, selection criterion and deterministic tie-break. For candidate configurations compare validation macro F1, then validation balanced accuracy, then simpler model. Do not retroactively change baseline checkpoints.

test_policy.status: previously observed comparison set; future results exploratory
test_policy.evaluation: One final inference after the candidate configuration/checkpoint is frozen; no threshold or calibration fitting on test.
test_policy.fresh_confirmation: A separate untouched cohort or properly nested group-aware evaluation is needed for a new confirmatory generalization claim. No new holdout has been created.

label_policy: Keep supplied labels unchanged. Model errors and mixed-label printed-ID groups are review flags, not proof of incorrect diagnosis. Evidence-backed corrections require a versioned dataset and renewed group-leakage audit.
hardware: CPU or supported MPS; small local baseline; no paid cloud required
scientific_limits: printed IDs are not verified patients
folder labels are not independently adjudicated
pixel columns are not a validated time axis
